Hourly peak wind gust (m/s) if available; else NaN
Relative humidity (%) derived from temp and dew point
1-hour precipitation accumulation (mm); NaN if not reported

Dataset from which the label was derived
Free-text quality notes (e.g. cloud contamination, gap-filled weather)
